intro: ごろ (頃) blurs a point in time: "around then". It attaches to a clock time, a date or a season, never to an amount. It is the time-point partner of くらい, which blurs amounts.

skills.rule: [point in time] ごろ means "around [that time]"; に after it is optional.
skills.explain:
Attach ごろ directly to a time you could mark on a clock or calendar: 七時ごろ, 五月ごろ, 来年の春ごろ. 何時ごろ asks "around what time?". After ごろ, に is optional: 七時ごろ起きます and 七時ごろに起きます are both correct. Never put に before ごろ.

ごろ cannot follow a length of time or any other amount: 二時間ごろ is wrong; use 二時間くらい. In casual speech 三時くらい is also heard for a clock time, but the standard choice for a point in time is ごろ.

After の or その the word is usually ころ, unvoiced: そのころ ("back then"), 子供のころ ("when I was a child"). Directly after a time word it is ごろ. このごろ ("these days") is a fixed word. まで ("until") and に alone (an exact time) have different meanings.

examples.jp: 毎朝[まいあさ]七時[しちじ]{ごろ}起[お]きます。
examples.en: I get up at around seven every morning.

examples.jp: 何時[なんじ]{ごろ}帰[かえ]りますか。
examples.en: Around what time will you be home?

examples.jp: 三時[さんじ]{ごろ}に駅[えき]で会[あ]いましょう。
examples.en: Let's meet at the station at around three.

examples.jp: 来年[らいねん]の春[はる]{ごろ}、日本[にほん]に行[い]きたいです。
examples.en: I'd like to go to Japan around next spring.

examples.jp: 桜[さくら]は四月[しがつ]の初[はじ]め{ごろ}に咲[さ]きます。
examples.en: The cherry blossoms come out around the beginning of April.

contrast.note: くらい blurs an amount (二時間くらい, "about two hours"); ごろ blurs a point in time (二時ごろ, "around two o'clock").
七時に is exactly seven; 七時ごろ is around seven. They can combine as 七時ごろに, in that order.
七時まで is "until seven": the end of a period, not an approximate moment.

mistakes.bad: 二時間[にじかん]{ごろ}待[ま]ちました。
mistakes.good: 二時間[にじかん]{くらい}待[ま]ちました。
mistakes.note: Two hours is an amount of time, so it takes くらい.

mistakes.bad: 十時[じゅうじ]に{ごろ}寝[ね]ます。
mistakes.good: 十時[じゅうじ]{ごろ}寝[ね]ます。
mistakes.note: ごろ attaches straight to the time word; if you want に, it comes after: 十時ごろに.

skills.tip: A moment on the clock or calendar: ごろ. A length or amount: くらい.
